scope: Received N100 records, diagnostics, executed code and measurement instructions; no new model execution.

policy.originals: Local originals remain under .local/originals; all copied bytes are hashed.
policy.tracked: Text evidence; only declared user-home-prefix redactions. Numeric observations and outliers retained.
policy.artifacts: ONNX, OpenVINO XML/BIN and pilot WAV files are local-only; archive stays outside the repository.
policy.cache: One generated bytecode file excluded from import; its original identity remains listed.
policy.checksum_note: Original preflight/PC SHA256SUMS name original bytes. Use verify.py for the declared tracked derivatives.
